properties.fixme: The boundary between Temes and Krassó counties seems to have been changed slightly in several places between the 2nd and 3rd surveys; the dates for these changes remain obscure.
properties.name: Temes vármegye
properties.name:ru:note: Cyrillic transliteration of the (Hungarian) name c.1909 (i.e. before the 1918 spelling reform)

properties.fixme: The boundary between Temes and Krassó(-Szörény) counties seems to have been changed slightly in several places between the 2nd and 3rd surveys; the dates for these changes remain obscure.
properties.name: Temes vármegye
properties.name:ru:note: Cyrillic transliteration of the (Hungarian) name c.1909 (i.e. before the 1918 spelling reform)
properties.note: Kusić/Кусић seems to have belonged to Krassó(-Szörény) at some point(s) but the dates are unclear. It has been presumed that it changed when Krassó-Szörény was established (1881)
